blind.B1: Yes. GSE132520 is the paper's own RNA-seq (S4.26.p1, S9.p1): quadriceps of male MM(WT) and VV mice, sedentary or after one bout of submaximal treadmill exercise (S4.23.p1). All 16 samples are exercise-relevant: 8 exercised, 8 sedentary.
blind.B2: MM exercised vs MM sedentary (582 genes) and VV exercised vs VV sedentary (216 genes, 180 shared), n = 4 mice per group (S2.3.p1, FIG3 b,c). MM vs VV after exercise is only used for IPA with a 2-sigma list (S4.26.p2).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one quadriceps per mouse, 4 independent mice per group. The litter key from the title prefix is not a pairing key (0 of 16 samples linked, duplicates inside each level).
blind.B4: The paper does not say how the fit was structured (S4.26.p1 defers to Tables S2-4). The GEO data_processing field names Cuffdiff, which compares pairs of groups; not stated in the paper text.
blind.B5: FDR-adjusted q-value < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff (S2.3.p1; FIG3 legend c). Counts: MM 582, VV 216, shared 180 (83% of VV). IPA input uses genes over +-2 sigma (S4.26.p2), which is not the DEG rule.

checks.evidence: Series has a sedentary and an exercised arm in both genotypes; run decision matches B1.
grp levels MMSED/MMEX/VVSED/VVEX, 4 each, match FIG3 b n = 4; titles agree with characteristics; no exclusions; control is the same-genotype sedentary group.
Contrasts are EX vs SED within genotype (control SED); exploratory VV vs MM uses MM as control.

Flag unused_subject_like_column on source_name_ch1 is a false positive: it is the genotype x treatment label (4 values, 4 samples each), not an animal ID. Litter links 0/16 samples across levels; paper has one muscle per mouse (S4.23.p1).

Paper is silent (S4.26.p1); GEO names Cuffdiff, which fits pairs. Record uses one joint ~0+grp model on 16 samples and declares it as a deviation. Counts are 4x and 7x lower than the paper, but the gap is plausibly due to the method (limma-trend on FPKM vs Cuffdiff), not the fit structure. No pairwise 8-sample fit is reported.
checks.fix: Optional: add per-genotype 8-sample limma fits as a sensitivity run next to the joint fit.

checks.evidence: Litter crossed with group is recorded (covariance.confounding). Note: L2161 appears only in exercised cells (4 of 8 EX) and L2032/L2127 only in MM sedentary, so litter is partly aliased with exercise; the record rejects it as a covariate with a reason (not in paper's design, df).

File is FPKM (non-integer, max 28112, median 1.6); log2(x+1) then limma-trend, not rounded into counts. P-value histogram shows frac_p>0.9 = 0.08, frac_p<0.05 = 0.11, no pile-up near 1. 32 NaN cells recorded.

Applied padj < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff, matches S2.3.p1 and FIG3 legend c. No other rule in packet B matches both paper counts (582/216) either: padj<0.1 gives 1226/1075, pvalue<0.05 gives 217/108 for MM/VV, so no rule-fit discrepancy to record.

Ours vs paper compares the same within-genotype EX vs SED contrasts at the same FDR rule. HANDBACK states the absolute counts are 4x/7x lower and reproduces only qualitative findings (MM > VV, VV DEGs mostly in MM: 29/31 vs 180/216); it does not claim equality.
No stop or refusal in this case; the Cuffdiff route is declared blocked because only FPKM is deposited, which is true (no BAM or counts in GEO, supplementary_file_1 NONE besides the FPKM xlsx).

human_items: Joint versus pairwise fits when the paper is silent (open policy question): the record uses one joint model; the paper's tool (Cuffdiff via GEO field) fits pairs.
summary: 该案例运行决策与论文一致：16个样本为2x2的基因型x运动设计，每组4只小鼠，无重复测量；阈值为FDR<0.05且无倍数变化限制，已准确转录。标志unused_subject_like_column是误报（source_name_ch1只是分组标签）。差异基因数比论文少4到7倍，源于只有FPKM可用、改用limma-trend，已声明为偏离；联合模型与成对拟合的选择属于开放政策问题，仅作次要提示。
